spans.s:
लोल a. [लोड्-अच् डस्यलः, लुल् घञ्
वा]
1 Shaking, rolling, tremulous,
moving to and fro, quivering,
dangling, trembling; flowing, waving (as
locks of hair);
परिस्फुरल्लोलशिखाग्रजिह्वं जगाज्जिघत्संतमिवांतवह्निं

.
--2 Agitated, disturbed, restless,
uneasy.
--3 Fickle, inconstant,
changing, unsteady; येनः श्रियः
संश्रयदोषरूढं स्वभावलोलेत्ययशः प्रमृष्टं

.
--4 Frail,
transient; Ś. 1. 10.
--5 Longing or
anxious for, eager for, eagerly desirous of
(mostly in comp.); अग्रे लोलः
करिकलभको यः पुरा पोषितोऽभूत्

.
--6 Greedy, lustful.
--ला
1 N.
of Lakṣmī.
--2 Lightning.
--3 The
tongue.
--Comp.
--अक्षि n. a rolling
eye.
--अक्षिका a woman with
rolling eyes.
--जिह्व a. with a rolling
or restless tongue, greedy.
--लोल a.
excessively tremulous, ever
restless.

.
--2 Very destructive, destroying
(Ved.).
--पा Ardent longing,
eager or earnest desire,
eagerness.

लोलुभ a. Ardently desirous,
covetous, see लोलुप.
